title: Full-Stack MERN Development
description: End-to-end full-stack web applications built with MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. Clean client-server architecture with state management, form validation, and responsive mobile-first UI.

title: RESTful API & Backend Engineering
description: Developing robust, modular REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js, featuring comprehensive middleware pipelines, standardized error handling, data validation, and third-party API integrations.

title: Database Architecture & MongoDB

title: UI Design Systems & Modern Frontend

title: Authentication, Security & Payments
description: Implementing secure user authentication, session management, and role-based access control (RBAC), alongside seamless payment gateway integrations with Stripe and SSLCommerz.

title: AI-Assisted Software Engineering
